newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent prices slide with NYMEX futures.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent prices slide with NYMEX futures.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot unleaded gasoline and diesel fuel prices slumped in late afternoon trade, tracking volitile NYMEX futures markets, industry sources said.

But differentials were generally steady as players watched the NYMEX screen bounce. October heating oil futures rose to post-Gulf War highs earlier today before slumping to losses on profittaking, traders said.
Cash offers, boosted in recent sessions by talk of a cat cracker down at Farmland Industries Inc's 68,600 barrel per day Coffeyville, Kansas refinery, slumped as NYMEX rose.
Traders said the outage was seen lasting up to two weeks and halved crude throughput at the key Group Three refinery.
Group Three prompt unleaded gasoline differentials eased to 0.75 cent a gallon under the print, with premium 2.75 cents higher.
Group Three low sulphur diesel was talked at even to 0.50 cent a gallon under the print for prompt September barrels.
Chicago September gasoline slipped to 1.25 cent under the print with premium talked 3.0 cents higher.
Chicago low sulphur diesel fuel eased to 0.50/0.75 cent a gallon under the print.
-- Franklin Paul, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
